ovādūpasaṅkamana: [ovāda + upasaṅkamana] (na) CL=7 Approaching for the sake of teaching or instruction. Approaches for requesting ' gives instructions'.
ovārenta: [ava + vara + a(ṇe) + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is concealing and blocking.
ovadeyyu: [ava + vada + eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should discipline or admonish. See - Ovadati.
ovaditu: [ava + vada + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To teach or to preach.
ovadisu: [ava + vada + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They disciplined or admonished. See - Ovadati.
ovaritu: [ava + vara + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cover and block. See - Ottarituṃ.
